title: Add search for facet capabilities in InstantSearch.js
body:
**This is for instantsearch.js**

## Use case

There is no search for facet values. It means that a user using a refinement list does not have the ability to search into the values. We conduct a small UX study and this is the next step, the actual implementation.

![screenshot 2016-12-09 14 56 28](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/393765/21051252/b1181614-be1f-11e6-90ae-5c9e636deeff.png)

## Proposed API

Use the current refinementList widget and add two new options:
 - *searchForValues*: boolean - true if we want the end user to be able to search for facet values
 - *searchPlaceholder*: string - the placeholder used
